SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS members_contacted,
    COUNT(*) AS total_exposures
FROM fact_campaign_exposure
WHERE campaign_id = 19

SELECT 
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.member_key) AS members_with_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_key 
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure 
    WHERE campaign_id = 19
) c ON f.member_key = c.member_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'

-- Get members contacted in Spring Garden Launch 2026 and their spending 4-24 May 2026
WITH campaign_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON fce.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
),
store_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS total_spending
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_member dm ON fsl.member_key = dm.member_key
  INNER JOIN campaign_members cm ON dm.member_id = cm.member_id
  WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
    AND ds.store_id < 900  -- physical stores only
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
),
web_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS total_spending
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON fsl.receipt_id = fwo.web_order_id
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_member dm ON fsl.member_key = dm.member_key
  INNER JOIN campaign_members cm ON dm.member_id = cm.member_id
  WHERE CAST(TIMEZONE('Europe/Helsinki', fwo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND fwo.status != 'cancelled'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_members) AS members_contacted,
  COALESCE((SELECT total_spending FROM store_sales), 0) + 
  COALESCE((SELECT total_spending FROM web_sales), 0) AS total_spending_eur

-- Verify member contact count by looking at the raw exposure data
WITH campaign_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, COUNT(DISTINCT fce.exposure_id) as exposures
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON fce.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
  GROUP BY m.member_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS unique_members,
  SUM(exposures) AS total_exposures,
  MIN(exposures) AS min_contacts_per_member,
  MAX(exposures) AS max_contacts_per_member,
  AVG(exposures) AS avg_contacts_per_member
FROM campaign_members

-- Check for returns during the period that affect our campaign members
WITH campaign_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON fce.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
  SUM(frl.refund_net) AS total_refunds_net,
  COUNT(*) AS return_line_count
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_member dm ON frl.member_key = dm.member_key
INNER JOIN campaign_members cm ON dm.member_id = cm.member_id
WHERE frl.return_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'

-- Calculate net sales (after returns) for campaign members during May 4-24
WITH campaign_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON fce.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
),
store_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS sales_amount,
    0 AS returns_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_member dm ON fsl.member_key = dm.member_key
  INNER JOIN campaign_members cm ON dm.member_id = cm.member_id
  WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
    AND ds.store_id < 900  -- physical stores only
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
),
web_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS sales_amount,
    0 AS returns_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON fsl.receipt_id = fwo.web_order_id
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_member dm ON fsl.member_key = dm.member_key
  INNER JOIN campaign_members cm ON dm.member_id = cm.member_id
  WHERE CAST(TIMEZONE('Europe/Helsinki', fwo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND fwo.status != 'cancelled'
),
returns_during_period AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(frl.refund_net) AS returns_amount
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  INNER JOIN dim_member dm ON frl.member_key = dm.member_key
  INNER JOIN campaign_members cm ON dm.member_id = cm.member_id
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE frl.return_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_members) AS members_contacted,
  COALESCE((SELECT sales_amount FROM store_sales), 0) + 
  COALESCE((SELECT sales_amount FROM web_sales), 0) - 
  COALESCE((SELECT returns_amount FROM returns_during_period), 0) AS net_sales_eur
